source: Re-verified 2026-09-07 (core/verify_gem_choices.py-equivalent methodology, active chase-bonus set forced empty first so an ALREADY-listed item can be genuinely re-checked, not compared against itself - see revalidate_chase_bonus.py in NOTES.md). Real, necessary consequence of the 2026-09-06 phase-legal-gem fix: gem_optimizer._all_gems() now also excludes unique/requiredProfession-gated gems, so the off-color "best gem of this color" representative used to build a chase-bonus loadout got weaker for several colors (e.g. RED: "Crimson Sun" 33131, unique+Jewelcrafting-only, excluded -> "Bright Crimson Spinel" 32197). Any item whose real win margin depended on that now-illegal substitute flips to a real, resolved loss; the original two items (28517, 32352) are the real, re-confirmed 30k-iteration result from that pass, no override needed (their own real verification never hit the tie-break trap below). Everything else added 2026-09-07, all with real gem overrides in the map above, needed because chase_bonus_gems_for_item()'s own crude-score fallback (used when no override exists) can pick a DIFFERENT, real-sim-confirmed-worse gem than the actually-verified winner (see gem_optimizer.py's own module notes on why crude score alone isn't trusted for this): 29095 (Pauldrons of Malorne, +2.15 DPS, gems match wowsims.com's own real picks exactly) and 29343 (Haramad's Leggings of the Third Coin, +2.02 DPS) found by manually re-checking her real currently-equipped gear (not covered by verify_gem_choices.py's own candidate-pool-only sweep); 30233/31040/30235/31049/34446/24250/34169 found by re-running that same sweep against her real candidate pool with the fixed methodology (real-sim-tested gem shortlist, meta requirement held valid throughout) - see gem_choice_verification.json's own real, resolved deltas (all clear of noise, +1.25 to +2.56 DPS each).
